title: Raas Garba Festival 2026 Sat, Oct 10th - 7:30 Pm
description: Immerse in the Vibrance of the BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival 2026
long_description:
Immerse in the Vibrance of the BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival 2026
Mark your calendars for the upcoming BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival on the 10th of October, 2026. This traditional Gujarati celebration is sure to immerse you in the vibrant spirit of Navratri. As the night unfolds, you will witness a beautiful fusion of music, dance, and culture, making it an unforgettable experience. Join us at 7:30 PM for an evening filled with rhythm, color, and joy.
Meet Our Talented Artists
While we are yet to announce the artists for this grand event, rest assured that they will be some of the best in the field. Seasoned performers who have dedicated their lives to the art, they will captivate you with their exceptional talent. Stay tuned for more updates on our artist lineup, we promise it will be worth the wait.
Explore the Enchanting Venue of Shreemaya Krishnadham Haveli
The festival will be held at the beautiful Shreemaya Krishnadham Haveli located at 175 Nortech Parkway, San Jose, CA. Nestled in the heart of the city, the venue provides a safe and accessible environment for all. The Haveli is known for its stunning architecture, spacious setting, and warm ambience. Parking facilities are available for your convenience. After the event, you can explore a myriad of nearby Indian restaurants that offer a delightful culinary experience.
Secure Your Tickets Today!
Don't miss out on this enchanting festival. Tickets are now available for purchase. For adults, the tickets are priced at $25.00. For children aged between 5 to 12 years, and seniors aged 70 and above, tickets are available at a discounted price of $20.00. Grab your tickets today and get ready to immerse yourself in a night of mesmerizing performances and vibrant celebrations.
